-- Track which player has the UI open and which mat they're editing
matChooserState = {
    playerColor = nil,  -- Which player has the UI open
    matGUID = nil       -- GUID of the mat being edited
}

function onLoad()
    -- Register the textures for the UI
    local assets = {}
    for i, data in ipairs(MAT_IMAGES) do
        -- Use thumb if available, otherwise fallback to full url
        local imgUrl = data.thumb or data.url
        table.insert(assets, {
            name = "Mat_Thumb_" .. i,
            url = imgUrl
        })
    end
    UI.setCustomAssets(assets)

    -- Ensure UI starts hidden
    Wait.frames(function()
        UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "false")
    end, 1)
end

-- Called by mat objects to open the chooser UI
function openMatChooser(params)
    local playerColor = params.playerColor
    local matGUID = params.matGUID
    
    -- Store state
    matChooserState.playerColor = playerColor
    matChooserState.matGUID = matGUID
    
    -- Show UI to this player only
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "visibility", playerColor)
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "true")
end

-- Called when close button is clicked
function closeMatChooser(player, value, id)
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "false")
    matChooserState.playerColor = nil
    matChooserState.matGUID = nil
end

-- Called when a mat thumbnail is clicked
function selectMatImage(player, value, id)
    -- Extract index from button ID (format: "MatSelect_Index")
    local indexStr = id:match("%d+$")
    if not indexStr then return end
    
    local index = tonumber(indexStr)
    local data = MAT_IMAGES[index]
    if not data then return end
    
    -- Find the mat object
    local matObj = getObjectFromGUID(matChooserState.matGUID)
    if not matObj then
        printToColor("Mat object not found!", player.color, {1, 0.3, 0.3})
        return
    end
    
    printToAll("Changing Mat to: " .. data.name, {0.2, 0.8, 0.2})
    
    -- Tell the mat to change its image
    matObj.call("changeMatImage", {url = data.url})
end

--- SHIP SCRIPT V8.2 16/02/2026
-- Vectored and Monitor Scripts added
-- V 8.1: Fix Cross Client Jitter, Add Deployment done button
-- V7.6: Fixed HUD orientation (removed per-frame rotation)
-- V7.7: Throttled movement UI, measurement line, and player-color syncing
-- UpgradeFunctionality
-- Player Colour UIs

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Variables That Change Per ship
local SHIP_ID = "SHIPTEMPLAT" -- This needs to be changed to allow for new stats to be saved
local Shiphealth = 2       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 30     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 2        -- cost variable
local ShipScan = 2          -- Scan range in inches (NEW)
local ShipThrust = 2 		-- Ship Thrust Value
local Signature = 2        -- Ship Signature Variable
local SHIPCardURL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/2dModel/MissingNo.png" -- Stat Card for the Ship
local FIXED_IMAGE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Ship Art/30mmTestImage.png" -- Ship Fixed Image Configuration
local Model3DExists = true  -- Set to true if this ship has a 3D model available
local TARGET_MESH_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/3DModels/Template/GenericShip.obj" -- Ship 3D Model Assets/3DModels/Template/GenericShip.obj
local TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/" -- Ship 3D Texture Assets/3DModels/Template/MedCOLIDER.obj

-- Ship-type flags
local Vectored = false   -- default, we will use this later
local Monitor  = false   -- if true, hide CourseChange and MaxThrust order buttons






-- Player Color: determines which team this ship belongs to ("Red" or "Blue")
-- Used for UI backdrop and future team-specific features
local playerColor = "Blue"

-- Backdrop URLs per player color
local BACKDROP_URLS = {
    Red  = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/UI/SHIPUI/MainMenuRed.png",
    Blue = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/UI/SHIPUI/MainMenuBlue.png",
}

local admiralLevel = 0      -- Admiral level (0 = none, 1-6)
local pendingUpgrade = nil   -- Stores upgrade data while waiting for player confirmation
local deployMode = true      -- When true, HUD is hidden and "Finish Deploy" button is shown instead
local spikeCapRemoved = false  -- When true, spike cap of 4 is disabled
local preAtmosphereThrust = nil    -- Stores thrust before atmosphere entry
local orbitRecoveryPending = false -- True when ship has exited atmosphere and needs one move at reduced thrust

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Vector movement Controller variables
-- Vectored thrust (extra bend once per move)
local vectoredPhase = 1          -- 1 = first leg, 2 = second leg (after the bend)
local vectoredLeg1Distance = 0   -- distance moved in phase 1 (in inches)
local vectoredReminderActive = false  -- shows a small HUD reminder between leg 1 and leg 2
local courseChangeReminderActive = false
local cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local BigUI_Height = -50  -- Default for 30mm, will be updated in onLoad

local FIXED_IMAGE_WIDTH = 200
local FIXED_IMAGE_HEIGHT = 200
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_X = 0
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_Y = 0
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_Z = -225 -- Negative Height Up from Base
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_X = 90  -- X-axis rotation (pitch)
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_Y = 270  -- Horizontal rotation
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_Z = 90  -- Vertical tilt

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ RADIAL MOVEMENT CONFIGURATION ----------------------
local MAX_RANGE = 10
local MAX_TURN_ANGLE = 45
local MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD = 0.1
local SMOOTH_SPEED = 6
local MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS = true
local DRAW_RAIL_LINE = true
local UNIT_SCALE = 1.0
local LINE_Y_OFFSET = 0.05

-- Movement state variables
local isHeld = false
local holdingPlayerColor = nil
local pivotPosition = nil
local startRotation = nil
local startForwardVec = nil
local currentSmoothedPos = nil
local courseChangePhase = 1  -- Track phase for Course Change: 1 or 2
local courseChangeDistance = 0  -- Track distance moved in phase 1
local pickupPosition = nil
local pickupRotation = nil
local lastMeasurementRotY = nil  -- Cache to avoid redundant measurement line updates

-- Movement Tracking
local accumulatedDistance = 0
local lastMovementText = ""  -- Cache to avoid redundant UI updates

--- =========================================================
-- 3D MODEL TOGGLE - WITH SCALE MANAGEMENT
-- =========================================================
local Model3DAvailable = false

local PLACEHOLDER_MESH_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/"
local PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/"

local SHIP_CHILD_NICK = "SHIP3dmodel"
local modelAttachmentIndex = nil  -- Track which index the model is at

-- Scale management
local savedModelScale = nil  -- Store the original scale
local PLACEHOLDER_SCALE = 0.001  -- Extremely small (invisible)

local function IsFreeMove()
    return deployMode == true or ((state and state.conditions and (state.conditions.MoveOff or 0) > 0) and true or false)
end


function findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    if not attachments or #attachments == 0 then
        return false
    end

    -- If we know the index, try it first
    if modelAttachmentIndex ~= nil then
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(modelAttachmentIndex)

        if obj then
            local data = obj.getData()
            if data and data.Nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK then
                -- Save current scale if switching TO placeholder
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                end

                -- Update mesh/diffuse
                obj.setCustomObject({
                    mesh = meshUrl,
                    diffuse = diffuseUrl
                })

                -- Update scale
                if targetScale then
                    obj.setScale(targetScale)
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
                return true
            else
                -- Wrong object, put it back
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
        modelAttachmentIndex = nil  -- Clear invalid cache
    end

    -- Search through all attachments
    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(i)

        if obj then
            local objType = obj.type or "unknown"
            local data = obj.getData()
            local nickname = data and data.Nickname or ""

            -- Check if this is our model
            if nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK or objType == "Custom_Model" then
                -- Save current scale if switching TO placeholder
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                end

                -- Update the mesh/diffuse
                local success, err = pcall(function()
                    obj.setCustomObject({
                        mesh = meshUrl,
                        diffuse = diffuseUrl
                    })
                end)

                if success then
                    -- Update scale
                    if targetScale then
                        obj.setScale(targetScale)
                    end

                    modelAttachmentIndex = i  -- Cache the index
                else
                    print("  ERROR updating: " .. tostring(err))
                end

                -- Reattach at the SAME index
                self.addAttachment(obj)

                return success
            else
                -- Not our model, put it back
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

function apply3DModelState()
    local meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale

    if Model3DAvailable then
        -- Switching TO target model
        meshUrl = TARGET_MESH_URL
        diffuseUrl = TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL

        if savedModelScale then
            -- Restore saved scale
            targetScale = savedModelScale
            savedModelScale = nil  -- Clear saved scale
        else
            targetScale = nil  -- Keep current scale
        end
    else
        -- Switching TO placeholder
        meshUrl = PLACEHOLDER_MESH_URL
        diffuseUrl = PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL
        targetScale = {x = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE, y = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE, z = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE}
    end

    local success = findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)

    if success then
        print("SUCCESS: 3D Model toggled!")

        -- Refresh the entire ship UI to show/hide fixed image
        Wait.frames(function()
            RefreshShip()
        end, 2)
    end
end

function debugListAllAttachments()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()

    if not attachments or #attachments == 0 then
        return
    end

    -- Temporarily remove each one to inspect it
    local detachedObjects = {}

    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(0)  -- Always remove from index 0
        if obj then
            table.insert(detachedObjects, obj)
        end
    end

    -- Reattach everything in reverse order
    for i = #detachedObjects, 1, -1 do
        self.addAttachment(detachedObjects[i])
    end
end

local function ClearAllMovementLines()
    -- Clears any native TTS vector lines on this object
    pcall(function()
        self.setVectorLines({})
    end)

    -- If you also draw UI lines somewhere else, call that here if it exists
    -- Example: if you have a function that redraws/clears measurement lines
    if ClearMeasureLine then
        pcall(function() ClearMeasureLine() end)
    end

    -- If you spawn physical line helper objects and track them, destroy them
    if state and state.rotationLineGuids then
        for _, guid in ipairs(state.rotationLineGuids) do
            local o = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if o then pcall(function() o.destruct() end) end
        end
        state.rotationLineGuids = {}
    end
end


-- Keep for compatibility
function safeGetAttachments(obj)
    if not obj then return {} end
    local ok, atts = pcall(function() return obj.getAttachments() end)
    if ok and type(atts) == "table" then return atts end
    return {}
end

function safeGetData(obj)
    if not obj then return nil end
    local ok, data = pcall(function() return obj.getData() end)
    if ok then return data end
    return nil
end

function safeGetCustomObject(obj)
    if not obj then return nil end
    local ok, co = pcall(function() return obj.getCustomObject() end)
    if ok then return co end
    return nil
end

-- Cached visual lines
local cachedFiringArcLines = nil
local cachedScanLines = nil
local cachedSignatureLines = nil
local cachedLaunchLines = nil

function setUIHeightsFromScale(baseSize)
    local scaleStr = baseSize

    if scaleStr == 30 then  -- 30mm
        BigUI_Height = -50
    elseif scaleStr == 40 then  -- 40mm
        BigUI_Height = -55
    elseif scaleStr == 50 then  -- 50mm
        BigUI_Height = -60
    elseif scaleStr == 60 then  -- 60mm
        BigUI_Height = -65
    else
        print("Warning: Unknown base scale " .. scaleStr .. ", using default UI heights")
        BigUI_Height = -50
    end
end

-- =========================================================
-- SPAWNER PARAM INJECTION ENTRY POINT
-- =========================================================
function InitFromSpawner(params)
    print("InitFromSpawner RECEIVED:")
    for k, v in pairs(params) do
        print("  " .. tostring(k) .. " = " .. tostring(v))
    end

    if not params then
        print("InitFromSpawner: params is nil")
        return
    end

    -- NEW: Ship-type flags
    if params.vectored ~= nil then Vectored = (params.vectored == true) end
    if params.monitor  ~= nil then Monitor  = (params.monitor  == true) end


    -- Support for admiral level
    if params.admiral then
        admiralLevel = tonumber(params.admiral) or 0
        state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
        state.conditions.Admiral = admiralLevel
    end

    -- Ensure core tables exist before indexing anything
    state = state or {}
    state.health = state.health or {}
    state.base = state.base or {}

    -- Map values
    if params.shipID then SHIP_ID = tostring(params.shipID) end
    if params.baseSize then ShipbaseSize = tonumber(params.baseSize) or ShipbaseSize end
    if params.health then Shiphealth = tonumber(params.health) or Shiphealth end
    if params.sig then Signature = tonumber(params.sig) or Signature end
    if params.points then Shipcost = tonumber(params.points) or Shipcost end
    if params.scan then ShipScan = tonumber(params.scan) or ShipScan end
    if params.thrust then ShipThrust = tonumber(params.thrust) or ShipThrust end

    if params.cardFrontImage then SHIPCardURL = tostring(params.cardFrontImage) end
    if params.modelImage then FIXED_IMAGE_URL = tostring(params.modelImage) end

    -- Support for player color
    if params.playerColor then playerColor = tostring(params.playerColor) end

    -- NEW: Support for 3D model availability
    if params.has3DModel ~= nil then
        Model3DExists = params.has3DModel
        print("  3D Model Available: " .. tostring(Model3DExists))
    end

    if params.name then self.setName(tostring(params.name)) end
    if params.faction then self.setDescription("Faction: " .. tostring(params.faction)) end

    -- SAFE table writes
    state.health.current = Shiphealth
    state.health.max = Shiphealth

    state.base.size = ShipbaseSize
    state.sig = Signature
    SignatureStorage = SignatureStorage or Signature

    -- Only call these if they exist in your ship script
    if getScaleFromBaseSize then
        local targetScale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
        if targetScale then
            self.setScale({targetScale, targetScale, targetScale})
            if setUIHeightsFromScale then setUIHeightsFromScale(targetScale) end
        end
    end

    if rebuildAssets then rebuildAssets() end

    if ui then self.UI.setXml(ui()) end

    if RefreshModelShape then RefreshModelShape() end
    if showMeasurementLine then showMeasurementLine() end
    if RecalculateSignature then RecalculateSignature() end
    if updateAuraVisuals then updateAuraVisuals() end

    print("InitFromSpawner OK: " .. self.getName())
end

-- =========================================================
-- SET PLAYER COLOR (called from spawner card after spawn)
-- =========================================================
function SetPlayerColor(params)
    if params and params.playerColor then
        playerColor = tostring(params.playerColor)
        print("Player color set to: " .. playerColor)
        rebuildAssets()
        self.UI.setXml(ui())
    end
end

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil,
    sig_aura_obj = nil,
	measurement_line = nil
};

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
TEXT_COLOR = TEXT_COLOR or "#FFFFFFFF"
OUTLINE_COLOR = OUTLINE_COLOR or "#000000"
OUTLINE_SIZE = OUTLINE_SIZE or "2 2"

local SignatureStorage = 0  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0           -- Tracker for Silent running
local BROADCAST_CHANNEL = "Ship_Activation_Reset"
local arcsProjected = 0  -- Tracker for projected arcs

----------------How Big are you? ---------
function getScaleFromBaseSize(baseSize)
    if baseSize == 30 then
        return 1.0
    elseif baseSize == 40 then
        return 1.3
    elseif baseSize == 50 then
        return 1.7
    elseif baseSize == 60 then
        return 2.15
    else
        print("Warning: Unknown base size " .. baseSize .. ", using default scale 1.0")
        return 1.0
    end
end
-----------------------------------------

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0,
        Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0,
		Silent_Running = 0, ProjectArcs = 0, ShipCard = 0, Status = 0, SpecialOrders = 0, MoveOff = 0, Launch = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
    sigAuraShown = false,
    sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil },
    positionHistory = {},
    moveNumber = 5,
    fractionNumber = 0,
    statusMenuOpen = false,
    specialOrdersMenuOpen = false,
    activeSpecialOrder = "GeneralQuarters",
    shipCardEditMode = false
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = nil },
    Red = { rotation = nil },
    Black = { rotation = nil },
    Grey = { rotation = nil }
};

-- New variable to track the current UI mode
local currentUIMode = 0  -- 0: High Visibility, 1: Subtle

local UI_SCALE = 0.5  -- Adjust this value to scale all UI elements
local BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000CC"  -- More opaque background
local TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFFFF"  -- Bright white text
local OUTLINE_COLOR = "#000000"
local OUTLINE_SIZE = "3 3"  -- Thicker outline

-- Tooltip definitions for all buttons
local TOOLTIPS = {
    CloseShipCard = "Close Ship Card",

function generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
    cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = {}

    if not pivotPosition or not startForwardVec then return end

    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()
    local guideLen = 5 * UNIT_SCALE

    local leftLimitVec  = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y',  MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

    local leftEnd  = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec  * guideLen)
    local rightEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * guideLen)

    -- Convert to local space so setVectorLines works correctly
    local localOrigin = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
    localOrigin.y = localOrigin.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

    local localLeft  = self.positionToLocal(leftEnd)
    localLeft.y  = localLeft.y  + LINE_Y_OFFSET
    local localRight = self.positionToLocal(rightEnd)
    localRight.y = localRight.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

    table.insert(cachedCourseChangeGuideLines, {
        points    = { localOrigin, localLeft },
        color     = {1, 1, 1},
        thickness = 0.08,
        rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
    })
    table.insert(cachedCourseChangeGuideLines, {
        points    = { localOrigin, localRight },
        color     = {1, 1, 1},
        thickness = 0.08,
        rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
    })
end

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    -- Calculate scan radius to match scan lines
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * (10/3) * UNIT_SCALE

    -- Set arc line length to 16" (extends 16" on each side = 32" total)
        local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
        local arcLineLength = 16 * UNIT_SCALE / scale

    -- Helper to add symmetric lines with custom color
    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        -- Line 1 (Right side) - extends from -arcLineLength to +arcLineLength
        local p1 = rotRight * arcLineLength
        local p2 = rotRight * (-arcLineLength)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        -- Line 2 (Left side)
        local p3 = rotLeft * arcLineLength
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-arcLineLength)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    -- Front/Side/Rear (45 degrees) - Dark Red
    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})

    -- Front/Rear Narrow (11 degrees) - Dark Blue
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}    -- Light Green

    -- Circle Scan Range - use ShipScan variable
    local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * UNIT_SCALE / scale

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function onPickUp(player_color)
      -- Reset move tracker when starting a new radial move
      accumulatedDistance = 0
      UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()

      -- Check if MoveOff is active - if so, skip radial movement setup
      -- If Free Move is active (or deploying), radial movement and vectored logic are disabled
      if IsFreeMove() then
          isHeld = false

          -- Hard reset any in-progress vectored / course-change sequencing
          vectoredPhase = 1
          vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
          vectoredReminderActive = false

          -- Optional but recommended, avoids “half-complete” states lingering
          courseChangePhase = 1
          courseChangeDistance = 0

          return
      end


    isHeld = true
    holdingPlayerColor = player_color

    -- Store pickup position/rotation for undo (do this FIRST)
    pickupPosition = self.getPosition()
    pickupRotation = self.getRotation()

    -- Record the position and rotation where the object was picked up
    pivotPosition = self.getPosition()  -- Always use current position as pivot
    startRotation = self.getRotation()
    currentSmoothedPos = self.getPosition()

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"

    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- Do NOT auto-advance phases on pickup.
        -- Phases are advanced onDrop (especially important for vectored ships).
        if courseChangePhase == nil then courseChangePhase = 1 end
        if courseChangeDistance == nil then courseChangeDistance = 0 end
    else
        -- Reset Course Change tracking when leaving the order
        courseChangePhase = 1
        courseChangeDistance = 0
    end


    -- VECTORED: two-leg movement for ANY order (except CourseChange, which already has its own 2-phase logic)
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        -- If we completed leg 1 previously, next pickup becomes leg 2
        if vectoredPhase == 1 and vectoredLeg1Distance > 0 then
            vectoredPhase = 2
            print("[FFAA00]Vectored: Phase 2 - extra 45° bend then remaining move [-]")
        elseif vectoredPhase ~= 2 then
            -- Starting fresh
            vectoredPhase = 1
            vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
        end
    else
        -- Not vectored (or CourseChange), always reset vectored state
        vectoredPhase = 1
        vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
    end


    -- Determine the starting "Forward" vector based on the model configuration
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformRight() -- Local X-axis
    else
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformForward() -- Local Z-axis
    end
    -- Flatten Y to ensure 2D calculations
    startForwardVec.y = 0
    startForwardVec:normalize()
end

function onDrop(player_color)
    -- TRACKING: Add current segment to accumulated distance
    if isHeld and pickupPosition then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local dist = Vector.distance(pickupPosition, currentPos) / UNIT_SCALE
        accumulatedDistance = accumulatedDistance + dist
        -- Update UI immediately
        UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
    end

    isHeld = false
    holdingPlayerColor = nil

    -- Clear physics velocities to prevent "fling" effect on release
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))

    local freeMove = IsFreeMove()
    if freeMove then
        -- If they free-moved the ship, never progress vectored/course change sequencing
        vectoredPhase = 1
        vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
        vectoredReminderActive = false

        -- Keep aura visuals correct
        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- COURSE CHANGE: phase progression handled onDrop
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
        local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
        local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

        if not Vectored then
                    -- Normal Course Change: Phase 1 (move) -> Phase 2 (rotate only) -> reset
                    if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                        if movedDistance > 0.1 then
                            courseChangeDistance = movedDistance
                            courseChangePhase = 2
                            courseChangeReminderActive = true
                            generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
                            broadcastToAll("[22AA22]Course Change: Phase 1 complete - Moved " ..
                                string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) ..
                                " inches. Pick up again to rotate (NO MOVEMENT) [-]")
                        else
                            courseChangePhase = 1
                            courseChangeDistance = 0
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                        end
                    else
                        -- Finished rotate-only stage
                        courseChangePhase = 1
                        courseChangeDistance = 0
                        courseChangeReminderActive = false
                        cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                    end

        else
            -- VECTORED + Course Change: Phase 1 (leg1 move) -> Phase 2 (leg2 move) -> Phase 3 (rotate only) -> reset
            if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                            -- Record leg 1 distance (allow 0 for "bend early" play)
                            courseChangeDistance = math.max(0, movedDistance)
                            courseChangePhase = 2
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false  -- Not yet at rotate phase
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                            print("[22AA22]Course Change (Vectored): Leg 1 complete - " ..
                                string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) ..
                                "\" moved. Pick up again for Vectored leg 2 [-]")

                        elseif courseChangePhase == 2 then
                            -- Completed leg 2, now go to rotate-only
                            courseChangePhase = 3
                            courseChangeReminderActive = true
                            generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
                            print("[FFAA00]Course Change (Vectored): Leg 2 complete. Pick up again to rotate (NO MOVEMENT) [-]")

                        else
                            -- Completed rotate-only
                            courseChangePhase = 1
                            courseChangeDistance = 0
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                        end
        end
    end

    -- VECTORED: after phase 1 drop, lock in leg 1 distance and require a second pickup for the remainder.
    -- After phase 2 drop, reset back to phase 1 for next movement.
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        if vectoredPhase == 1 then
            -- Record how far we moved on leg 1 (in inches)
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
            local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
            local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

            -- Store even if it is 0 (turn-at-start use case)
            vectoredLeg1Distance = math.max(0, movedDistance)
            vectoredPhase = 2

            print("[22AA22]Vectored: Phase 1 complete - " ..
                string.format("%.1f", vectoredLeg1Distance) ..
                "\" moved. Pick up again for extra bend + remaining move [-]")
            broadcastToAll("First part of vectored move complete, Move again to complete move", {1, 0.67, 0})
            vectoredReminderActive = true
            Sync()

        elseif vectoredPhase == 2 then
            vectoredPhase = 1
            vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
            vectoredReminderActive = false
            Sync()
        end
    end

    -- ORBIT RECOVERY: restore original thrust after one move post-atmosphere exit
    if orbitRecoveryPending then
        orbitRecoveryPending = false
        local shipName = self.getName() or "Unknown Ship"
        local restoredThrust = preAtmosphereThrust or ShipThrust
        ShipThrust = restoredThrust
        preAtmosphereThrust = nil
        print("[22AA22]" .. shipName .. " has successfully reached orbit, it's thrust is now " .. ShipThrust .. "\"[-]")
        Sync()
    end

    -- Update visuals based on Aura state
    updateAuraVisuals()
end

function updateRadialMovement(player)
    local pointerPos = player.getPointerPosition()

    -- Get movement parameters based on active special order
    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()

    -- 1. Calculate Direction and Distance
    local diffX = pointerPos.x - pivotPosition.x
    local diffZ = pointerPos.z - pivotPosition.z
    local directionVec = Vector(diffX, 0, diffZ)
    local currentDist = directionVec:magnitude()

    -- 2. Deadzone / Movement Threshold Check
    if currentDist < MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD * UNIT_SCALE then
        self.setPosition(pivotPosition)
        self.setRotation(startRotation)
        self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
        self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

        currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition

        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- 3. Calculate Direction & Clamp Angle
    local moveDir = directionVec:normalized()

    -- Calculate angle difference between Start Forward and Current Direction
    local angleDiff = Vector.angle(startForwardVec, moveDir)

    -- Check if angle exceeds limit (use dynamic max turn angle)
    if angleDiff > MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC then
        local cross = startForwardVec:cross(moveDir)
        local sign = 1
        if cross.y < 0 then sign = -1 end
        moveDir = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', sign * MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    end

    -- 4. Calculate New Position with MIN and MAX range
    local targetPos  -- Declare here so it's available throughout the function

      -- Special handling for Course Change order
      local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"

      -- Decide if this phase is "rotate-only"
      local rotateOnly = false
      if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
          if Vectored then
              -- Vectored Course Change: Phase 3 is rotate-only
              rotateOnly = (courseChangePhase == 3)
          else
              -- Normal Course Change: Phase 2 is rotate-only
              rotateOnly = (courseChangePhase == 2)
          end
      end

      if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and rotateOnly then
          -- Rotate-only stage: NO MOVEMENT
          targetPos = pivotPosition
      else
          -- Standard clamping (includes Course Change phase 1 and vectored phase 2)
          local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
          local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
          local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
          targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
      end


    -- Preserve the object's current height
    local currentHandPos = self.getPosition()
    targetPos.y = currentHandPos.y

    -- Smooth interpolation
    if currentSmoothedPos == nil then currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition end
    currentSmoothedPos = currentSmoothedPos:lerp(targetPos, Time.delta_time * SMOOTH_SPEED)
    currentSmoothedPos.y = targetPos.y
    self.setPosition(currentSmoothedPos)

    -- 5. Calculate Rotation
    local targetAngle = moveDir:heading("y")
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        targetAngle = targetAngle - 90
    end
    self.setRotation(Vector(0, targetAngle, 0))

    -- 6. Physics Cleanup
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

    -- 7. Visual Feedback
    local finalLines = {}

    -- Add Aura visuals if enabled (firing arcs + scan)
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
                    for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
                end
            end

            if (state.conditions.Launch or 0) > 0 and cachedLaunchLines then
                for _, l in ipairs(cachedLaunchLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
            end

        if DRAW_RAIL_LINE then
        local visualDir = moveDir
        local shipOffset = currentSmoothedPos - pivotPosition
        shipOffset.y = 0

        if shipOffset:magnitude() > 0.1 then
             visualDir = shipOffset:normalized()
        end

        -- Use dynamic max range for visual
        local railEnd = pivotPosition + (visualDir * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localStart = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
        localStart.y = localStart.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localEnd = self.positionToLocal(railEnd)
        localEnd.y = localEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Use dynamic max turn angle for limit lines
        local leftLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
        local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

        local leftLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)
        local rightLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        -- COURSE CHANGE PHASE 2 ROTATION GUIDES
        -- Draw short 5" guide lines so players can visualise the allowed rotation when range is 0
        if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and ((not Vectored and courseChangePhase == 2) or (Vectored and courseChangePhase == 3)) then
            local guideLen = 5 * UNIT_SCALE

            local leftGuideEndWorld  = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec  * guideLen)
            local rightGuideEndWorld = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * guideLen)

            local localLeftGuideEnd  = self.positionToLocal(leftGuideEndWorld)
            localLeftGuideEnd.y = localLeftGuideEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

            local localRightGuideEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightGuideEndWorld)
            localRightGuideEnd.y = localRightGuideEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftGuideEnd },
                color = {1, 1, 1},
                thickness = 0.08,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightGuideEnd },
                color = {1, 1, 1},
                thickness = 0.08,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end


        local localLeftEnd = self.positionToLocal(leftLimitEnd)
        localLeftEnd.y = localLeftEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localRightEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightLimitEnd)
        localRightEnd.y = localRightEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Main range line (white)
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localEnd },
            color = {1, 1, 1},
            thickness = 0.1,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })

        -- Only draw turn limit lines if turning is allowed
        if MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC > 0 then
            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end

        -- Draw minimum range circle if MIN_RANGE > 0
        if MIN_RANGE > 0 then
            local minCirclePoints = {}
            local segments = 32
            local step = 360 / segments
            for i = 0, segments do
                local angle = math.rad(i * step)
                local x = math.cos(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local z = math.sin(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local worldPos = pivotPosition + Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z)
                table.insert(minCirclePoints, self.positionToLocal(worldPos))
            end

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = minCirclePoints,
                color = {1, 1, 0},  -- Yellow for minimum range
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function getMovementParameters()
    -- Safety check - ensure ShipThrust exists
    if not ShipThrust or ShipThrust == 0 then
        ShipThrust = 9  -- Default value
    end

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    local halfThrust = ShipThrust / 2
    local fullThrust = ShipThrust
    local doubleThrust = ShipThrust * 2

    -- Base parameters for the current order
    local baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn

    if activeOrder == "GeneralQuarters" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 45

    elseif activeOrder == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "WeaponsFree" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

      elseif activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
          -- COURSE CHANGE:
          -- Normal ship: Phase 1 = move up to half thrust, Phase 2 = rotate only
          -- Vectored ship: Phase 1 = move leg 1, Phase 2 = move leg 2 (vectored bend), Phase 3 = rotate only

          if Vectored then
              if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                  -- Leg 1: up to half thrust
                  return 0, halfThrust, 45
              elseif courseChangePhase == 2 then
                  -- Leg 2: remaining distance up to half thrust, allow bend (45)
                  local leg1 = courseChangeDistance or 0
                  local remainingMax = math.max(0, halfThrust - leg1)
                  return 0, remainingMax, 45
              else
                  -- Phase 3: rotate only, no movement
                  return 0, 0, 45
              end
          else
              -- Normal non-vectored Course Change behaviour (your original)
              if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                  return 0, halfThrust, 45
              else
                  return 0, 0, 45
              end
          end


    elseif activeOrder == "MaxThrust" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = fullThrust, doubleThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "DamageControl" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = 0, halfThrust, 45

    else
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 45
    end

    -- VECTORED override (applies to any order except CourseChange)
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        if vectoredPhase == 1 then
            -- Leg 1: MIN disabled, so you can do 0 move then bend at start
            return 0, baseMax, baseTurn

        elseif vectoredPhase == 2 then
            -- Leg 2: remaining distance, and MIN enforced by total (leg1 + leg2)
            local remainingMax = math.max(0, baseMax - (vectoredLeg1Distance or 0))
            local remainingMin = math.max(0, baseMin - (vectoredLeg1Distance or 0))

            -- Extra bend allowance: at least 45° for leg 2, even if baseTurn is 0
            local turn2 = math.max(baseTurn or 0, 45)

            return remainingMin, remainingMax, turn2
        end
    end

    -- Default: base order params
    return baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn
end

-- Update the ModifyCondition function to handle fractionNumber wrapping (0-9)
function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            -- Special handling for FractionNumber
            if params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                -- Increment or decrement and wrap around 0-9
                local newValue = (previousValue + params.amount) % 10
                if newValue < 0 then newValue = 9 end  -- Handle negative wrap-around
                state.conditions[params.name] = newValue
                state.fractionNumber = newValue  -- Update the state variable
            else
                state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
            end
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        if params.name ~= "MoveNumber" and params.name ~= "FractionNumber" then
            print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        else
            if params.name == "MoveNumber" then
                state.moveNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            elseif params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                state.fractionNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            end
        end
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

    local shipName = self.getName() or "Unknown Ship"

    if nowInAtmosphere and not wasInAtmosphere then
        -- Entering atmosphere
        preAtmosphereThrust = ShipThrust
        orbitRecoveryPending = false
        ShipThrust = 2
        print("[4488FF]" .. shipName .. " has entered Atmosphere! Thrust locked to 2\" (was " .. preAtmosphereThrust .. "\")[-]")

    elseif not nowInAtmosphere and wasInAtmosphere then
        -- Exiting atmosphere
        if preAtmosphereThrust then
            local penaltyThrust = math.max(0, preAtmosphereThrust - 4)
            orbitRecoveryPending = true
            ShipThrust = penaltyThrust
            print("[FFAA00]" .. shipName .. " is rising to orbit and loses 4\" of Thrust, It's thrust is currently " .. penaltyThrust .. "\" for it's next move[-]")
        else

function UI_ModifyMove(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            if not self.getLock() then
                self.setLock(true)
            end

            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local directionMultiplier = alt == '-2' and -1 or 1

            local deltaX = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local newPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            self.setPosition(newPos)

            local direction = directionMultiplier == 1 and "forward" or "backward"
            local modelName = self.getName()

            local colorCode = directionMultiplier == 1 and "22AA22" or "AA2222"
            print(modelName .. " has moved " ..
                "[" .. colorCode .. "]" .. direction .. "[-][F4641D] " ..
                string.format("%.1f", moveAmount) .. "[-] inches ")

            showMeasurementLine()
        end
    end
end

function ProjectArcsForward()
    if state._projectingArcs then return end
    state._projectingArcs = true

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.6})

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end

    state._projectingArcs = false
end

function ResetArcs()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())

        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint(clr)

        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())

                end
            end
        ]])
    end
end

local function _xmlEscape(s)
    s = tostring(s or "")
    s = s:gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">"):gsub('"', """):gsub("'", "'")
    return s
end

local function _normaliseSummaryForLog(summary)
    summary = tostring(summary or "")
    -- Replace unicode arrows with safer ASCII (TTS fonts sometimes render unicode inconsistently)
    summary = summary:gsub("→", "->")
    return summary
end

local function AddUpgradeLogEntry(upgradeName, summary)
    -- Ensure container exists
    state = state or {}
    state.upgradeLog = state.upgradeLog or {}

    local line = tostring(upgradeName or "Unknown Upgrade") .. ": " .. _normaliseSummaryForLog(summary)
    table.insert(state.upgradeLog, line)

    -- Keep log bounded so it cannot grow forever
    local MAX_LOG_LINES = 30
    while #state.upgradeLog > MAX_LOG_LINES do
        table.remove(state.upgradeLog, 1)
    end
end

    local upgradeObj = getObjectFromGUID(params.upgradeGUID)
    if upgradeObj then
        upgradeObj.call("resetTrigger", {})
    end
    return

    ShipThrust = ShipThrust + pendingUpgrade.thrust
    table.insert(appliedParts, "Thrust → " .. ShipThrust)

    table.insert(appliedParts, "Points → " .. Shipcost)

    ShipScan = ShipScan + pendingUpgrade.scan
    generateScanLines()
    updateAuraVisuals()
    table.insert(appliedParts, "Scan → " .. ShipScan)
end

    admiralLevel = pendingUpgrade.admiral
    state.conditions.Admiral = admiralLevel
    table.insert(appliedParts, "Admiral Lvl " .. admiralLevel)
end

print("[22AA22]" .. self.getName() .. " applied upgrade '" .. pendingUpgrade.upgradeName .. "': " .. summary .. "[-]")

AddUpgradeLogEntry(pendingUpgrade.upgradeName, summary)


local upgradeObj = getObjectFromGUID(pendingUpgrade.upgradeGUID)
if upgradeObj and not upgradeObj.isDestroyed() then
    upgradeObj.destruct()
end

pendingUpgrade = nil
Sync()
end

function UI_DeclineUpgrade(p, alt)
if alt == '-3' then return end
if not pendingUpgrade then return end

local upgradeObj = getObjectFromGUID(pendingUpgrade.upgradeGUID)
if upgradeObj and not upgradeObj.isDestroyed() then
    upgradeObj.call("resetTrigger", {})
end

print("[AAAAAA]" .. self.getName() .. " declined upgrade '" .. pendingUpgrade.upgradeName .. "'[-]")

pendingUpgrade = nil
Sync()
end
